name: strict_mag_identity
gap: Portals that reject the hardcoded MAG250 identity (image_version 218 / hw 1.7-BD-00) and only accept a MAG254/Ministra profile answer 'Authorization failed.' as plain text. TWO gaps: (1) we send ONE identity with no preset ladder, so there is no recovery; (2) the rejection is NOT detected during authentication -- get_profile's rejection is ignored and we carry on to the content call, only surfacing the error there. A preset ladder would need to notice it at get_profile to know to retry with another identity.
